questions.question: Caching'da thundering herd muammosi nima?
questions.explanation: Yuqori trafikli cache key expire bo'lganda minglab request bir vaqtda cache miss qilib DB'ga uriladi va uni yiqitadi. Yechim: mutex/singleflight (faqat bittasi DB'ga boradi) yoki probabilistic early expiration (XFetch).

questions.question: Cache penetration, cache breakdown va cache avalanche farqi.
questions.explanation: Penetration: mavjud bo'lmagan key so'rovlari cache'ni chetlab DB'ga boradi (yechim: Bloom filter, null qiymatni qisqa TTL bilan cache'lash).

questions.question: Bloom filter nima?
questions.explanation: Joy tejaydigan ehtimoliy struktura: element to'plamda "albatta yo'q" yoki "bo'lishi mumkin" ekanini aytadi (false positive bor, false negative yo'q) — keraksiz DB lookup'larni kesadi.

questions.question: Read-through, write-through va write-back caching farqi.
questions.explanation: Read-through: ilova cache'dan so'raydi; miss'da cache o'zi DB'dan oladi.

questions.question: Connection pool hajmi formulasi (HikariCP) qanday?
questions.explanation: pool size = (core count × 2) + effective spindle count. Juda katta pool CPU context switching va xotira sarfini oshiradi — ko'pincha kichik pool tezroq.

questions.question: DB read-write splitting nima?
questions.explanation: Yozuvchi tranzaksiyalar (INSERT, UPDATE) primary'ga, o'qishlar (SELECT) asinxron read replica'larga yo'naltiriladi. Replication lag tufayli read-your-writes muammosini hisobga oling.

questions.question: DB sharding va shard key tanlash nima?
questions.explanation: Qatorlarni shard key hash'i bo'yicha mustaqil fizik DB instance'larga gorizontal bo'lish (hash(user_id) % num_shards). Yaxshi key: yuqori cardinality, bir tekis taqsimot, so'rovlar bitta shard'da qoladi.

questions.question: Consistent hashing nima?
questions.explanation: Node va key'lar virtual halqaga map qilinadi; node qo'shish/olib tashlash faqat ~K/N key'ni qayta joylaydi (oddiy % N da deyarli hammasi ko'chadi). Virtual node'lar bilan taqsimot tekislanadi.

questions.question: Two-Phase Commit (2PC) nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta DB bo'ylab atomik commit protokoli: 1-faza (prepare/vote) → 2-faza (commit/abort). Bloklovchi; coordinator yiqilsa ishtirokchilar lock ushlab qoladi.

questions.question: Distributed store'da vector clock nima?
questions.explanation: Node'lar bo'ylab mantiqiy timestamp — event'larning qisman tartibini aniqlash va concurrent (causal) write konfliktlarini topish uchun.

questions.question: Gossip protokoli nima?
questions.explanation: Node'lar vaqti-vaqti bilan tasodifiy peer'lar bilan holat almashadigan decentralized P2P protokol — klaster a'zoligi va sog'ligi tarqaladi (Cassandra, Consul).

questions.question: Paxos va Raft farqi.
questions.explanation: Paxos: matematik jihatdan nafis, lekin tushunish va to'g'ri implementatsiya qilish juda qiyin.

questions.question: Lease-based lock nima?
questions.explanation: Client'ga cheklangan vaqtga (TTL) beriladigan lock; client yiqilsa lease o'zi tugaydi va deadlock bo'lmaydi.

questions.question: Distributed locking'da fencing token nima?
questions.explanation: Lock servisi (etcd) beradigan monoton o'suvchi raqam. Storage eskiroq token bilan kelgan yozuvni rad etadi — GC pause'dan "uyg'ongan" eski lock egasi yangi yozuvni buza olmaydi.

questions.question: Redis bilan distributed rate limiting qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Redis ichida atomik Lua skript bilan foydalanuvchi/IP bo'yicha token bucket yoki sliding window hisoblagichini kamaytirish — barcha API gateway instance'lari bitta holatni ko'radi.

questions.question: Asinxron event-driven arxitektura (EDA) nima?
questions.explanation: Servislarni event stream (Kafka) va message queue (RabbitMQ) orqali ajratish: bloklanmaydigan aloqa, gorizontal scale, burst'larni yutish. Narxi: eventual consistency va murakkab debug.

questions.question: Streaming'da backpressure nima?
questions.explanation: Buffer to'lishga yaqinlashganda downstream consumer upstream producer'ga sekinlashishni bildiradigan flow-control mexanizmi.

questions.question: Idempotent consumer pattern nima?
questions.explanation: At-least-once yetkazishda takroriy xabar ikki marta side effect bermasligi uchun qayta ishlangan message_id lar dedup jadvalida (biznes yozuv bilan bitta tranzaksiyada) saqlanadi.

questions.question: DLQ reprocessing automation nima?
questions.explanation: Qayta ishlab bo'lmaydigan ("poison") xabarlarni DLQ'ga yo'naltirish, on-call'ga alert berish va bug tuzatilgach ularni qayta yuborish (redrive) uchun tool.

questions.question: Kafka'da log compaction nima?
questions.explanation: Partition'da har key uchun faqat eng oxirgi qiymat saqlanadi — topic distributed key-value changelog sifatida ishlaydi (tombstone = null qiymat key'ni o'chiradi).

questions.question: Blue-green deployment nima?
questions.explanation: Ikkita bir xil prod stack (Blue — aktiv, Green — yangi). Green health check'dan o'tgach load balancer'da trafik 100% bir zumda o'tkaziladi; rollback ham bir zumda. DB schema mosligini hisobga oling.

questions.question: Avtomatik metrika tahlili bilan canary deployment nima?
questions.explanation: Trafik bosqichma-bosqich (2% → 10% → 50% → 100%) o'tkaziladi, Prometheus error rate va latency so'rovlari baholanadi; yomonlashsa avtomatik rollback.

questions.question: Dark launching va feature flag farqi.
questions.explanation: Dark launching — backend sig'imini jonli shadow trafik bilan sinash; feature flag — UI imkoniyatlarini foydalanuvchi segmentlariga dinamik yoqish/o'chirish.

questions.question: GitOps (ArgoCD) da avtomatik rollback nima?
questions.explanation: Config repo'dagi commit'ni revert qilish — ArgoCD klaster holatini oldingi barqaror versiyaga reconcile qiladi. Git — yagona haqiqat manbai.

questions.question: Ephemeral preview environment lifecycle nima?
questions.explanation: Har Pull Request uchun Kubernetes'da to'liq izolyatsiyalangan muhit avtomatik yaratiladi va merge'da o'chiriladi.

questions.question: CI/CD'da shift-left security nima?
questions.explanation: Har commit'da merge'dan oldin secret scanning, SAST, SCA dependency scan, image scan va IaC lint majburiy.

questions.question: Supply chain security (SLSA Level 3) nima?
questions.explanation: Hermetic/izolyatsiyalangan build, avtomatik SBOM (CycloneDX), soxtalashtirib bo'lmaydigan provenance (in-toto) va Cosign bilan kriptografik imzo.

questions.question: Sigstore bilan keyless image signing nima?
questions.explanation: GitHub Actions OIDC token bilan image imzolanadi: Fulcio qisqa muddatli X.509 sertifikat beradi, imzo Rekor transparency log'ga yoziladi — uzoq muddatli kalit saqlash kerak emas.

questions.question: Kubernetes'da Zero Trust microsegmentation qanday?
questions.explanation: Default-deny NetworkPolicy va har pod orasida mTLS — VPC ichidagi yashirin tarmoq ishonchi yo'qotiladi.

questions.question: Vault dynamic secrets nima?
questions.explanation: Talab bo'yicha qisqa TTL'li vaqtinchalik DB credential yaratish; lease tugaganda avtomatik bekor qilinadi.

questions.question: Policy as Code (Kyverno va OPA Gatekeeper) nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes resurslarini etcd'ga yozilishidan oldin deklarativ siyosat kodi bilan validatsiya/mutatsiya qilish va image imzosini tekshirish (admission controller). Kyverno — YAML; Gatekeeper — Rego.

questions.question: Falco eBPF runtime security nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel syscall'larini real vaqtda kuzatib, container'dagi ruxsatsiz faoliyatni aniqlaydi (shell ochish, /etc/shadow o'zgartirish).

questions.question: CIS Benchmark hardening nima?
questions.explanation: Linux, Docker va Kubernetes uchun sanoat standarti xavfsizlik konfiguratsiya tekshiruvlari (masalan kube-bench).

questions.question: Least privilege RBAC governance nima?
questions.explanation: Foydalanuvchi, service account va workload'larga faqat vazifasi uchun zarur minimal ruxsat berish.

questions.question: Just-In-Time (JIT) elevated access nima?
questions.explanation: Prod'ga vaqtinchalik, vaqt bilan cheklangan (masalan 2 soat) yuqori ruxsat; avtomatik tugaydi va audit qilinadi.

questions.question: SRE error budget exhaustion policy nima?
questions.explanation: Error budget 0% bo'lganda muhim bo'lmagan reliz'lar muzlatiladi, muhandislik resursi reliability, test va texnik qarzga yo'naltiriladi.

questions.question: Multi-window multi-burn-rate alerting nima?
questions.explanation: Error budget sarflanish tezligi bir nechta oynada (masalan 1h va 5m, 6h va 30m) hisoblanadi — faqat jiddiy va davom etayotgan sarf bo'lganda page qilinadi (shovqin kam, aniqlash tez).

questions.question: SRE toil reduction framework nima?
questions.explanation: Toil soatlarini aniqlash, tasniflash va o'lchash, takroriy qo'l ishini dasturiy avtomatlashtirish bilan butunlay yo'qotish.

questions.question: Blameless post-mortem'da 5 Whys nima?
questions.explanation: Ketma-ket besh marta "Nega?" deb so'rab, yuzaki inson xatosidan tizimli, arxitektura va jarayon kamchiligigacha borish. (Cheklovi: bitta chiziqli sabab — murakkab tizimlarda bir nechta contributing factor bo'ladi.)

questions.question: On-call escalation matritsasi va rotatsiya nima?
questions.explanation: Bosqichli page jadvali (primary → secondary → engineering manager), avtomatik escalation timeout bilan — 24/7 javob kafolati.

questions.question: FinOps Inform, Optimize, Operate sikli nima?
questions.explanation: Xarajat ko'rinishi (Inform), right-sizing va chegirma imkoniyatlarini topish (Optimize), avtomatik governance o'rnatish (Operate) — doimiy sikl.

questions.question: Cloud unit cost metrikasi qanday hisoblanadi?
questions.explanation: Oylik cloud xarajati / oylik aktiv tranzaksiyalar (yoki boshqa biznes KPI) — infra samaradorligining haqiqiy o'lchovi.

questions.question: Kubernetes workload right-sizing nima?
questions.explanation: Container CPU/memory request va limit'larini tarixiy Prometheus foydalanish metrikalari asosida sozlash (VPA tavsiyalari) — isrofni yo'qotish.

questions.question: Karpenter'da Spot consolidation nima?
questions.explanation: Turli Spot instance turlarini dinamik provision qilib, pod'larni zich joylash (bin-packing) va bo'sh/kam yuklangan node'larni avtomatik birlashtirish.

questions.question: Infracost bilan shift-left cost estimation nima?
questions.explanation: PR'da infra o'zgarishining xarajat farqini avtomatik izoh sifatida yozadi — merge'dan oldin moliyaviy ta'sir ko'rinadi.

questions.question: AWS multi-account organization arxitekturasi nima?
questions.explanation: Workload'larni alohida akkauntlarga ajratish (Log Archive, Security, Shared Services, Dev, Prod), Service Control Policy (SCP) bilan boshqarish — blast radius va billing chegaralari.

questions.question: Aurora Global DB bilan multi-region active-active nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta region'da aktiv compute, trafik lokal klasterga; storage darajasida replikatsiya va secondary region'dan write forwarding. (Aurora Global'da yozuv baribir bitta primary region'ga ketadi.)

questions.question: Route 53 bilan avtomatik DR failover qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: DNS health check'lar region'lardagi /healthz ni kuzatadi; region yiqilsa DNS yozuvi avtomatik zaxira region'ga o'tadi (TTL va client cache'ni hisobga oling).

questions.question: Pilot Light va Warm Standby farqi.
questions.explanation: Pilot Light: ma'lumot doimiy replikatsiya; yadro infra minimal, avariyada ko'tariladi.

questions.question: AWS Direct Connect va Site-to-Site VPN failover qanday tashkil qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Asosiy — maxsus fizik optik ulanish (Direct Connect), zaxira — IPsec VPN; BGP dinamik routing avtomatik o'tkazadi.

questions.question: AWS Transit Gateway hub-and-spoke nima?
questions.explanation: Yuzlab VPC va on-prem data center'larni bog'laydigan markaziy virtual router — tranzitiv routing va markaziy inspeksiya.

questions.question: AWS PrivateLink (Interface VPC Endpoint) nima?
questions.explanation: VPC subnet'ini AWS servislariga (yoki boshqa akkaunt servisiga) public internetsiz, AWS ichki tarmog'i orqali ulaydigan private ENI.

questions.question: OpenTelemetry Collector multi-pipeline arxitekturasi nima?
questions.explanation: Metrics, logs va traces uchun mustaqil receiver → processor (batch, tail sampling, PII redaction) → exporter pipeline'lari.

questions.question: Distributed tracing'da span context propagation nima?
questions.explanation: W3C traceparent va tracestate header'larini HTTP va gRPC chegaralari orqali uzatish — trace bir butun bo'lib qoladi.

questions.question: Grafana Tempo arxitekturasi nima?
questions.explanation: Trace span'larini siqilgan holda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri object storage'da (S3/GCS) saqlaydi, Elasticsearch kerak emas — arzon.

questions.question: Grafana Loki label indekslash arxitekturasi nima?
questions.explanation: Faqat stream label metadata'si indekslanadi, xom log matni siqilib object storage'da saqlanadi — logging xarajati keskin kamayadi (label cardinality'ni past tuting).

questions.question: Pyroscope bilan eBPF continuous profiling nima?
questions.explanation: eBPF orqali barcha process'larning CPU instruction pointer'lari qat'iy chastotada sample qilinadi va flame graph'da bottleneck ko'rsatiladi.

questions.question: Prometheus TSDB compaction va WAL checkpoint nima?
questions.explanation: Sample'lar avval WAL va xotiradagi head block'ga yoziladi, 2 soatlik block'larga flush qilinadi, keyin kattaroq o'zgarmas block'larga compaction qilinadi; checkpoint WAL'ni qisqartiradi.

questions.question: Synthetic probing va Real User Monitoring (RUM) farqi.
questions.explanation: Synthetic — global nuqtalardan headless bot'lar user flow'ni muntazam tekshiradi (trafik bo'lmasa ham); RUM — brauzerdagi JS telemetriya haqiqiy foydalanuvchi latency'sini yig'adi.

questions.question: Enterprise DevOps operational excellence framework nima?
questions.explanation: Automation: 100% IaC va GitOps.
